evidence.quote: [Stan2012, Ch. 3 Exer. 135(b)] Let Λ n be the set of allp(n) partitions of the integern≥0. Order Λ n by refinement. Determine the M¨ obius functionµ(λ, ρ) of Λ n. (This is trivial whenλ=⟨1 n⟩and easy when λ= 1n−221 .)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer $n\geq 0$, let $\Lambda_n$ denote the set of all integer partitions of $n$ (so $|\Lambda_n|=p(n)$). Partially order $\Lambda_n$ by refinement: for $\lambda,\rho\in\Lambda_n$, declare $\lambda\leq\rho$ if and only if $\lambda$ can be obtained from $\rho$ by partitioning each part of $\rho$ into a sum of positive integers (equivalently, the parts of $\lambda$ can be grouped so that the sums of the groups give the parts of $\rho$). With this order, $\Lambda_n$ is a finite poset with minimum element $\langle 1^n\rangle$ (the partition into $n$ ones) and maximum element $\langle n\rangle$. Let $\mu$ denote the Möbius function of $\Lambda_n$, defined recursively by $\mu(\lambda,\lambda)=1$ and $\mu(\lambda,\rho)=-\sum_{\lambda\leq\sigma<\rho}\mu(\lambda,\sigma)$ for $\lambda<\rho$, and $\mu(\lambda,\rho)=0$ otherwise.

Problem: Determine, in closed combinatorial form, the Möbius function $\mu(\lambda,\rho)$ of the refinement poset $\Lambda_n$ for arbitrary $\lambda,\rho\in\Lambda_n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as Exercise 3.135(b) in Stanley's Enumerative Combinatorics with no general closed-form solution given; it is widely cited as an open problem in compendia of open problems on tableaux/partition combinatorics. Web searches turn up partial results (e.g., Möbius functions for partitions with restricted block sizes and for related set-partition lattices) but no general formula for $\mu(\lambda,\rho)$ on the refinement order of integer partitions of $n$.

status_evidence.title: The Möbius function of partitions with restricted block sizes
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Möbius functions on partition-type lattices with restrictions, indicating ongoing investigation of related Möbius problems.
status_evidence.claim: Related restricted versions are studied, but the general refinement-order Möbius function of integer partitions is not given in closed form.

status_evidence.title: Möbius Functions of Lattices (Sagan et al.)
status_evidence.snippet: General techniques for Möbius functions of lattices; the integer-partition refinement lattice's full Möbius function is not provided.
status_evidence.claim: No general closed formula for $\mu(\lambda,\rho)$ on the refinement order of integer partitions appears in the literature surveyed.
